findings.statement: Process provenance is consistent at the available commit granularity: D054 contract freeze 46ef477 (01:21:30+09:00) precedes D055 corrected freeze 904acb2 (01:29:43), which contains the preserved D054 FAIL log f456f3dd; D055 PASS evidence 4c6e3aba is committed by 148a936 (01:36:50); D056 contract freeze 5d9f521 (01:51:07) precedes the D056 raw report 8ea58a3a and gate-matrix closeout at 5f327804 (04:44:35). Raw D055/D056 reports bind the same accepted comparator hash 760a7c04 recorded in the evidence map. D054 remains a preserved FAIL, not overwritten or relabelled as PASS.
assumptions_used: Git commit order is adequate only at commit granularity; the raw reports are the registered evidence map paths.
counterevidence_refs: The D054 output and D055 reissue share commit 904acb2, so this evidence cannot establish their within-commit ordering.
unresolved: A signed or independently timestamped D054 execution receipt would be the decisive falsifier for a claimed post-r2-freeze D054 output.

findings.statement: Required anti-drift accountability is not evidenced for the aggregate D049-D056 chain. The evidence map records 209 changed files, +18,125/-71 (net +18,054) lines, with only +24/-9 comparator and +18/-5 focused-test changes, plus two tracked __pycache__ bytecode files. It does not provide per-PR added/deleted/net accounting, blocker-movement ratios, or cost-effectiveness verdicts for D049-D056. Token use is correctly available only as UNAVAILABLE, but that does not substitute for the missing accounting. Therefore no policy-compliant cost-effectiveness conclusion can be admitted from the declared evidence.
assumptions_used: The anti-drift policy requires per-PR accounting and a cost-effectiveness verdict; aggregate chain data cannot prove each PR complied.
counterevidence_refs: docs/audit/BD622_D056_gate_matrix_completion_2026-07-28.md records process gate flips and retained scope limits, but does not supply the missing per-PR cost ledger.
